title: Kodak launches KODAK PROSPER Plus 5 Imprinting System
summary: Kodak has launched the KODAK PROSPER Plus 5 Imprinting System, expanding its PROSPER Plus portfolio with a 152 mpm (500 fpm) solution that adds KODAK…
body_markdown:
Kodak has launched the KODAK PROSPER Plus 5 Imprinting System, expanding its PROSPER Plus portfolio with a 152 mpm (500 fpm) solution that adds KODAK Stream Inkjet Technology to existing presses and finishing lines. Designed for printers and converters, the PROSPER Plus 5 enables variable data printing, coding, serialization, personalization and versioning without replacing current equipment, giving them the flexibility to expand into higher-margin applications, respond faster to changing customer demands and generate new revenue from assets they already own.


With 600 x 900 dpi resolution, flexible drop size options and enhanced reliability, the PROSPER Plus 5 supports applications including direct mail, packaging, security printing, lottery and personal care, enabling printers pursue higher-value work from existing production assets.


Powered by Stream Technology and[KODAK EKTACOLOR Inks](https://www.kodak.com/en/print/product/digital/inks/ektacolor-inks/) , the new imprinting system combines image quality, speed and operational simplicity with the latest PROSPER Plus platform enhancements that are designed to improve serviceability, streamline connectivity and maximize up time in demanding production environments.


Kodak is also simplifying its existing portfolio by renaming PROSPER Plus 1/1W and PROSPER Plus 2/2W to PROSPER Plus 10 and PROSPER Plus 20, reflecting production speeds of 305 mpm (1,000 fpm) and 609 mpm (2,000 fpm). Together with the[KODAK PROSPER Print Bar](https://www.kodak.com/en/print/product/digital/prosper-print-bar/) , the PROSPER Plus family gives printers and converters scalable imprinting options. Existing[PROSPER S-Series](https://www.kodak.com/en/print/product/digital/imprinting/prosper-s-series/) customers will continue to receive full-service support, with upgrade options available as production needs evolve.


"This new addition to the PROSPER portfolio reflects our continued investment and ongoing commitment to the print industry. With the PROSPER Plus 5, Kodak is helping printers modernize existing production assets, unlock new revenue opportunities and deliver the personalization, traceability, and flexibility that today’s markets demand," commented Laura Cole, VP, Pricing and Product Management, Kodak.


KODAK PROSPER Plus 5 is available now worldwide. For more information visit[kodak.com/go/prosperplus](https://www.kodak.com/en/print/product/digital/imprinting/prosper-plus/) .
